verdict.rationale: Mintlify's custom-domain docs state that sites can be hosted on your own domain, subdomain, or subpath, with DNS records, automatic TLS certificates, and either Mintlify-managed or proxy traffic routing. The pricing page lists custom domain as a plan feature. Mintlify's own docs are served at the www.mintlify.com/docs subpath, which demonstrates the subpath pattern in practice. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of custom-domain and subpath setup, and detailed evidence of subpath proxy configuration steps (for example, specific reverse-proxy or host setups).
